gaps.what: Cliopatria's 'New France' row holds French colonies outside New France: Maranhao (1612-1625), Saint Martin (1626-1631), Guadeloupe/Martinique/Grenada (1636-), Fort-Dauphin (1645-1672), Senegal (1659-), Reunion (1670-1672), Ivory Coast (1691-), Seychelles (1757-1761), Guyana coast (1783-1790), Saint Pierre and Miquelon (1791). Removed from New France (verdict adjust/wrong); they will vanish from the map unless dossiers exist (saint-domingue and french-colony-of-guiana already do).

Cliopatria growth not explained by any page opened: Saint Lawrence cluster 1642, 1677, 1683; Texas and Wisconsin dots 1687-1691; Alabama and Michigan-Indiana dots 1718; Ile Saint-Jean 1721; Louisiana thickening 1721; claim fill 1734; Manitoba 1741. Recorded at confidence 1.

Undated on the pages: fall of Fort Duquesne and other Ohio forts (1758-1760, carried by the 1760 capitulation), Treaty of Breda 1667, Phips 1690, Louisbourg occupation 1745-1748, Acadian civil war 1640-1645, Beaver Wars; Montreal's founding.
No area comparison with the infobox: the New France page gives no area figure.

Matching events on the other side: english-colonial-empire lacks the Acadia 1654-1670, James Bay 1686-1697 and Port-Royal 1710 events; british-colonial-empire lacks the occupation and cession events of 1710-1713 and 1758-1763.
No area figure on either page; the Cliopatria shape includes the Fort Casimir cells, which were Dutch from 1651 to May 1654; east-bank Swedish land is dated by Fort Elfsborg (1643) only.
